about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Dale W. Strong

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CIVIL PREPAREDNESS FOR AGROTERRORISM EXERCISE ACT OF 2026
statements.title: CIVIL PREPAREDNESS FOR AGROTERRORISM EXERCISE ACT OF 2026
sentences: In just the past 1\1/2\ years, multiple foreign nationals have been charged or convicted for attempting to smuggle dangerous biological agents from China into the United States.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of my bill, H.R. 9394, the Civil Preparedness for Agroterrorism Exercise Act of 2026.
This is why I introduced H.R. 9394.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 9394 and help protect America's agricultural backbone.

statements.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: Mr. Chairman, I rise in opposition to this amendment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SPENDING AVIATION FEES FOR EQUIPMENT, GUARANTEEING UPGRADED AND ADVANCED RISK DETECTION AND SAFETY ACT OF 2026
statements.title: SPENDING AVIATION FEES FOR EQUIPMENT, GUARANTEEING UPGRADED AND ADVANCED RISK DETECTION AND SAFETY ACT OF 2026

Mr. Speaker, I urge all Members to support the SAFEGUARDS Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEFENDING AMERICAN PROPERTY ABROAD ACT OF 2026
statements.title: DEFENDING AMERICAN PROPERTY ABROAD ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the question is: Do we support President Trump with this authority?
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 7084, the Defending American Property Abroad Act of 2026.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 7084.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PAY OUR HOMELAND DEFENDERS ACT
statements.title: PAY OUR HOMELAND DEFENDERS ACT
sentences: The Democrats allowed 15 million illegal aliens to enter into this country under the last administration, and now they don't want to fund Homeland Security.
In many cases, they are being asked to do it without pay, all because Democrats want to block the deportation of violent criminals who are here illegally.

As a member of both the Appropriations Committee and the Homeland Security Committee, I rise today in strong support of the Pay Our Homeland Defenders Act, to ensure that our frontline personnel are paid and that our Nation is secure.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COMMERCE, JUSTICE, SCIENCE; ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT; AND INTERIOR AND ENVIRONMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: COMMERCE, JUSTICE, SCIENCE; ENERGY AND WATER DEVELOPMENT; AND INTERIOR AND ENVIRONMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: It provides strong support for State and local law enforcement partnerships, and it defends the Second Amendment and America's right to bear arms.

Republicans are working to advance regular order and deliver results for the American people--reliable and affordable energy, strong national security, safe communities, and long-term fiscal responsibility.

This bill ensures continued American dominance in space, making crucial investments that secure the future of the space launch system, human landing system, and nuclear thermal propulsion, for all of which Marshall Space Flight Center in north Alabama plays a central role.
This is a responsible bill that supports law enforcement, strengthens national security, and puts America first.
Mr. Speaker, as vice chair of the Commerce, Justice, Science, and Related Agencies Subcommittee, I rise in strong support of this legislation.
It provides strong support for State and local law enforcement partnerships
Mr. Speaker, I urge all Members to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING AN UPDATE TO THE AMERICAN PEOPLE
statements.title: PROVIDING AN UPDATE TO THE AMERICAN PEOPLE
sentences: The Working Families Tax Cut delivered the largest tax cut for middle- and working-class Americans in history, like no tax on tips and no tax on overtime.
It is a fact that the southern border is closed.

Under Biden, our emergency departments and local hospitals became the preferred free healthcare provider for illegal aliens, driving healthcare costs through the roof while the American taxpayers footed the bill.

Republicans cut $100,000 for climate resilience in Ghana; cut $360,000 for gender nonconforming, nonbinary, two-spirit farmers in New York; cut $24 billion to USAID; cut $22 billion from Health and Human Services to provide housing and cars for illegal aliens; cut $45 million for diversity, equity, and inclusion scholarships in Burma; cut $8 million to promote LGBTQ in Africa; cut $10 million for male circumcision in Mozambique; cut $20 million for the Arab ``Sesame Street'' in the Middle East; and we cut $600 million from National Public Radio.
The war between Israel and Hamas is over.
The Iranian nuclear program has been set back for decades, and the Middle East is more stable than it has been in years.
It is a fact that the Democrats' so-called Inflation Reduction Act raised the United States debt to more than $38 trillion.
It is a fact that Biden's Green New Deal was nothing more than another scam on the U.S. taxpayers, and ObamaCare, known as the Affordable Care Act, is not affordable to anyone in America.
We will never apologize for keeping America safe.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DHS BIODETECTION IMPROVEMENT ACT
statements.title: DHS BIODETECTION IMPROVEMENT ACT
sentences: I urge my colleagues to join me once again in supporting this commonsense bill to ensure the security of our communities against biological threats.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STRATEGIC HOMELAND INTELLIGENCE AND ENFORCEMENT LEGISLATION TO DEFEND AGAINST THE CCP ACT
statements.title: STRATEGIC HOMELAND INTELLIGENCE AND ENFORCEMENT LEGISLATION TO DEFEND AGAINST THE CCP ACT
sentences: There is no question that the Chinese Communist Party poses a clear and present threat to both the security and democracy of the United States of America.
These threats span across various sectors, including public safety, border and immigration, critical infrastructure, and economic security.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my legislation, H.R. 708, the SHIELD Against CCP Act.
I now urge all Members to join me once again in supporting the SHIELD Against CCP Act to protect our national security and safeguard our interests.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESEARCH SECURITY AND ACCOUNTABILITY IN DHS ACT
statements.title: RESEARCH SECURITY AND ACCOUNTABILITY IN DHS ACT
sentences: Whether the Department of Homeland Security is working to prevent a terrorist act, inhibiting drug traffic at the southwest border, or responding to a life-threatening natural disaster, DHS relies heavily on research and development projects to enhance its operational effectiveness.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 901, the Research Security and Accountability in DHS Act.

By passing this commonsense bill and protecting sensitive R&D projects throughout the Department, we will improve the effectiveness of DHS' mission, the safety of our Nation's law enforcers, and, ultimately, our national security.
I urge all Members to join me in supporting this vital piece of legislation to better safeguard DHS and the American people.
